decision: Final multi-fold runs use --proposals crossfit_eqm for all 5 folds; EQM fitted strictly on the calibration split (detector scores only). No adjustment towards TEST.

acceptance_by_fold.1: m_negative TRAIN-CF-EQM vs TEST p = 0.0086 (< 0.01); vs calibration not rejected
acceptance_by_fold.4: m_negative TRAIN-CF-EQM vs TEST p = 0.0014, m_all p = 0.0025; vs calibration p = 0.68 (m_negative), 0.88 (m_all)

interpretation: Folds 1 and 4 match the calibration split, on which the map is fitted, but deviate mildly from TEST in the negative-image proposal rate. The sealed detector's own negative-image proposal rate already differs between calibration and TEST (fold 4: 26.0% vs 33.7%), so the residual gap is attributed to natural sampling variation between the 321-image calibration split and TEST, not to a remaining cross-fit shift. Reported as-is; TEST is never used to fit or tune the map.
